controls: Null control A: 31 independent random-scalar sign-complete factor bases per curve.
Null control B: 31 independent random-x sign-complete factor bases per curve using the coordinate construction path.
Order control: four preregistered deterministic permutations of each four-term support map.
Compression control: scalar progression must have smaller four-term support and lower eight-term coverage than random medians.
Curve control: generator and verifier independently reject trace 0 or 1 and j 0 or 1728.
Hash control: generator, imported arithmetic, and independent verifier boundaries are SHA-256 bound.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Narrow H-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-002 if no coordinate family meets both-null support, coverage-efficiency, order-robust frontier, offline-cost, and six-of-nine replication gates.

inputs.field_modulus_policy: Seeded bit-size primes constrained to p mod 4 = 3; curves with trace 0 or 1 and j 0 or 1728 are rejected.

invalidation_rules: Any curve has trace 0 or 1, j 0 or 1728, composite order, cofactor above 1, or nonmonotone q for a seed.
Any null family has fewer than 31 independently seeded replicates on any curve.
Any exact four- or eight-term support, target witness, source hash, or percentile fails independent reconstruction.
Any Boolean or floating-point value occupies an exact integer protocol field.
Canonical generator or verifier run records a dirty Git tree.
A candidate is promoted from one null family, one support order, fewer than six clean instances, or fewer than all three sizes and seeds.

primary: exact four- and eight-term support sizes and paired-null percentiles
functional advice entries and deep bytes
online group operations under four support orders
order-robust functional S*T^2/(epsilon*q) percentile against both null families
secondary: factor-base construction and compiler field operations
estimated lookup traffic bytes and wrapper peak RSS
sampled successes and failed-target scan costs
measured Pollard-rho group operations as scale only

experiment.objective: Calibrate the verified sign-complete m=8 coverage signal against replicated paired nulls on non-special curves with order-robust online accounting.
stopping_rules: Stop a run at 900 seconds or 2 GiB peak RSS.
Stop a curve search after 256 coefficient attempts and retain an invalid run.
Do not promote a family unless it passes six of nine clean instances spanning all three sizes and all three seeds.
Do not call any percentile result split compression unless four-term support is at most 0.8x both null medians.
Do not fit an exponent from this null-calibration sweep.
experiment.success_criterion: Promote a family only if exact eight-term support and |8A|/|4A|^2 are at or above the 0.95 empirical percentile of both 31-replicate nulls, the order-robust functional frontier is at or above the 0.90 percentile of both nulls, order-seed median online work varies by at most 25 percent, offline group operations are at most 4.0x median random-x, and all conditions hold in at least six of nine clean instances spanning every size and seed. This promotes only a toy additive-geometry follow-up.
experiment.title: Replicated-null and order-robust recursive coverage calibration
